charts.title: HIP 113103 b: orbits around HIP 113103
charts.description: The orbits of HIP 113103's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HIP 113103 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Lowson et al. 2024 (2024MNRAS.527.1146L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname LOWSON_ET_AL_2024): P 7.610303 d

charts.title: HIP 113103 b: its transit
charts.description: HIP 113103 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (95, 96, 106) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 121490076, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 9-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 9-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
